newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIAN GOVERNMENT SUPPORTS 2004 EUROPEAN BID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIAN GOVERNMENT SUPPORTS 2004 EUROPEAN BID.

text.p: The Austrian government on Tuesday pledged its full financial support for a joint bid to host the European soccer championship finals 2004.
Chancellor Viktor Klima said the government would support the bid with 1.5 to two billion Austrian schillings ($123.3 million to $164.4 million).
"The government is backing the bid for the soccer championship," Klima told reporters after a weekly cabinet meeting.
The Austrian soccer federation has recommended neighbouring Hungary as ideal co-hosts. It is also negotiating with the Czech Republic, which also shares a border with Austria.
Both the Hungarian and Czech governments have pledged financial support for a joint bid with Austria.
European soccer's governing body UEFA is expected to make a decision on bids in 1998. Spain is considered a leading contender.
Belgium and the Netherlands will be the first joint hosts in 2000. ($ = 12.16 Austrian Schillings)
